items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And then after that, then I worked with Duke at the theatre down here. It used to be the old Rialto Theatre, and then they called it the Downtown, at Congress and State.

ctx.x: Pardon me. So that was -- that was the way these sessions -- and then, they had a battle of bands in there. See, Benny Moten's band would play at the Harlem and they would have Duke Ellington's band. And then it was one of those things where -- you know, and Benny and them --

Benny Moten's band was the greatest band for just sitting down -- and they would start off a tune, this was tunes like "Moten's Swing" and all those things. And then they'd start to setting these riffs.
